evidence.claim: Built in 1797, the federal outpost served both as a way station for migrants and a place of interaction between the Cherokee and the United States government.

evidence.quote: Among the first duties of the Southwest Point garrison was to remove individuals (known as "squatters") who had settled on Cherokee lands illegally.
